北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 30℃ 且湿度高，闷热！多补水，注意防暑。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels hot and humid today! Stay hydrated and prevent heatstroke.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨加 6级 大风，体感较凉。出行带伞，注意安全，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella, stay safe, and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感舒适。外出记得关注天气变化，小心着凉哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and pleasant. Stay aware of weather changes.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热，体感 32℃！紫外线强，记得防晒，多补充水分哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and hot (feels like 32℃)! Stay hydrated and use sunscreen.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴天，体感 30℃。阳光正好，出门别忘防晒，多喝水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like 30℃. Don't forget sunscreen and drink plenty of water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雨和 7级 大风，体感偏凉。出行务必注意安全，带好雨具！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has heavy rain and strong winds, feeling cool. Travel safely and bring your rain gear!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力 5级。出门请注意防风，早晚温差大，别着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast with moderate winds. Watch out for wind, and don't catch a cold!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100% 体感闷热！多补水，保持清爽舒适哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels humid (100%) and stuffy! Stay hydrated and cool.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉体感 34℃！天气炎热，风力 5级。注意防暑，多补充水分。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like 34℃! It's hot, so stay cool and hydrated.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 30℃，记得多喝水，注意防晒。阴天也要小心紫外线！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 30℃. Stay hydrated and don't forget sun protection, even on cloudy days!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆体感高达 38℃！天气酷热，请务必防暑，多喝水，小心中暑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing feels extremely hot, up to 38℃! Stay cool, hydrate, and avoid heatstroke.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，湿度 90%。体感舒适，记得保持心情愉快哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with 90% humidity. It feels pleasant, so enjoy your day!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，湿度 100% 闷热。注意防潮防蚊虫，保持室内通风。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and feels humid (100%) and stuffy. Stay vigilant against moisture and insects.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 22℃，天气舒适。记得多补充水分，保持好心情！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and feels comfortable at 22℃. Stay hydrated and keep a good mood!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 30℃，有点热。多喝水防暑，阴天也要注意防晒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 30℃, a bit hot. Stay hydrated, protect from sun even on cloudy days!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，湿度 94%，体感舒适略潮湿。注意防潮，保持心情。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 94% humidity, feeling comfortable but a bit damp. Watch out for moisture.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，风力 6级，体感较凉。出行请注意防风，多添衣物。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast with strong winds, feeling cool. Dress warmly and watch out for wind!
